purpose: Only free Hugeicons icon data, the MIT-licensed React renderer, and verified open-licensed remote assets may enter the pinned catalog. Unsafe or unverifiable assets are excluded.

@hugeicons/react.evidence: The publisher's 1.1.10 tarball contains an MIT LICENSE.md and a separate PRO-LICENSE.md. The package metadata declares MIT. Only the renderer is used.

@hugeicons/core-free-icons.evidence: The publisher's 2.0.0 package metadata declares MIT; the official Hugeicons repository identifies the free icon pack as MIT. No @hugeicons-pro import occurs in the pinned source.

verified.rights: Irrevocable, nonexclusive, worldwide copyright license to download, copy, modify, distribute, perform, and use photos from Unsplash for free, including for commercial purposes, without permission from or attributing the photographer.
verified.evidence: Photos hosted under https://images.unsplash.com/photo-* in animated-collection, expandable-gallery, feature-carousel, and vertical-tabs are free Unsplash photos. Previews and GHL exports remain self-contained.

unverified.reason: Unsplash+ terms prohibit use in digital templates. HigherBits distributes reusable UI components, so the original source asset remains held unless replaced or separately licensed.
Third-party private avatar API without documented open distribution rights or commercial license terms.
